name: AnySearch
description: Unified real-time AI search engine supporting web search, 17 vertical domains, parallel batch queries, and full-page Markdown content extraction. Free anonymous access available.
notes: Native Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint. Supports zero-config anonymous access or higher rate limits via API key.
installHint: Leave API key blank to start immediately with free anonymous access, or provide your AnySearch API key for increased quotas.

auth.credentialHelp: Optional. Leave blank for free anonymous access, or paste your API key from https://anysearch.com/console/api-keys for higher quotas.
